title: Real and Fake Ye Fan
summary: Word spreads that Ye Fan has imprisoned Jin Chi and Yaoguang's Holy Son and Holy Maiden, and Yaoguang offers 100,000 catties of source for his capture. In disguise, Ye Fan sells bounty hunters a fake lead to a cave, then robs them. In a restaurant in Shanshi City, a young master with a Four Poles attendant (Xia Jiuyou, disguised as a boy) and Yaoguang's Gu Litian, who has just entered the Four Poles, clash over the hunt. Duan De turns up as a Daoist fortune-teller, claims he can calculate Ye Fan's location, and sells it for 100,000 catties. Ye Fan and Hei Huang recognise his God Clone technique, track it to a teleportation formation and tamper with it so his crossing through the void goes wrong. Two days later Duan De leads the hunters to a fake Ye Fan, who boasts that he will kill every Holy Lord, pockets the source and slips away while Ye Fan follows.
